pages.scan: Top-left: caption 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' with ravi silent. Top-right: teal label 'WELBUK VISION' and caption 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.' with a silent specialist at lower right. Middle wide: teal label 'WELBUK VISION' again and caption 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.' with ravi, partner, child silent. Bottom wide: teal label 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health' at top; meera, ananya, ravi silent in the centre; caption at bottom 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.'
pages.observation: The page has no dialogue, only captions and labels. The speaker of 'us' and 'our hometown' is unclear (Ravi? the clinic? a narrator?). The shift to 'Tomorrow' does not say whether these panels are imagined, the future, or the present. The specialist, partner and child appear with no introduction; nothing shows they are Ravi's family or that the specialist is remote. 'WELBUK VISION' appears in two panels in a row, and 'The vision:' repeats the label, which is redundant. The specialist face box is tight against the lower-right corner of the caption. In the last panel the order is label, then faces, then the bottom caption, which reads fine. The three faces are evenly spaced with no interaction set up, so the art has to give them shared acting.
